trickyParts: The branch merges legion/INFRA-555 at ff571a0894e3 (key sets, signed sign-in state, server_processes registry) because item 3 reads that registry; pull request #2323 carries those commits until INFRA-555 (#2390) is on main, so it must merge after it. INFRA-555's migration is renumbered 0129 and ours 0130 in agreement with its implementer; dashboard.BuildID takes the id from processes.DashboardBuild (one build-id function).

The two-builds spec keys each pending /assets/ request to the document that made it: a page being left can start a lazy import between the wait and the next goto, and Chromium cancels it with neither requestfinished nor requestfailed.
The asset store read runs on a context no request cancels, bounded at 3 s, so a client that leaves cannot poison the singleflight read other requests share.
The document socket draws its reconnect delay when the socket opens, since the provider's dead-socket check calls onClose without a close event.
deviations: The browser walk's pending-request tracking was corrected after the red run (47c3ba79), keyed by document; the red run's failures were 404 responses, which the correction does not touch.

LiveDashboardBuilds lives in package api, not dashboard: dashboard imports routes, which imports api, so a helper in dashboard would be an import cycle; processes is INFRA-555's package and was not edited.
